sources.label: De-Vanced exists because the old way started getting frustrating, so I migrated
sources.author: De-Vanced
patch_list: Disable typing indicator
Disables the indicator while typing a message.
Hide Facebook buttons
Hides buttons and shortcuts that open Facebook.
Hide inbox ads
Hides ads in inbox.
Hide inbox stories and notes tray
Hides the stories and notes horizontal tray at the top of the inbox.
Hide inbox subtabs
Hides Home and Channels tabs between active now tray and chats.
Open links externally
Always opens links in your default browser instead of the in-app browser, regardless of the in-app setting.
Remove Meta AI
Removes UI elements related to Meta AI.
Spoof package version
Sets a very high version code so the Play Store treats the app as already up to date and never offers an update.

sources.label: New mask, same task.
sources.author: Doom
patch_list: Allow screen capture
Allows screenshots and screen recording in all conversations including end-to-end encrypted ones.
Block screenshot detection
Prevents Messenger from notifying other participants when you take a screenshot or screen recording.
Change package name
Installs Messenger beside the original by renaming the manifest package and provider authorities, removing duplicate permission declarations.
Disable media transcoding
Sends photos and videos at original quality without re-encoding.
Disable typing indicator
Disables the indicator while typing a message.
Enable chat heads
Enables chat heads (bubbles) for all devices regardless of API level or RAM class.
Hide Facebook buttons
Hides buttons and shortcuts that open Facebook.
Hide inbox ads
Hides ads in the Messenger inbox.
Hide inbox stories and notes tray
Hides the stories and notes horizontal tray at the top of the inbox.
Hide inbox subtabs
Hides Home and Channels tabs between active now tray and chats.
Open links externally
Opens links in the external browser instead of the in-app browser.
Remove Meta AI
Removes the Meta AI floating button, drawer items, and search suggestions.
Spoof package version
Sets a very high version code so the Play Store treats the app as already up to date and never offers an update.

sources.label: Morphe patches for Facebook Messenger. Privacy switches and fewer promotions.
sources.author: HushMessenger
patch_list: Allow chat bubbles

Lets you pick Stock, Chat heads or Android bubbles for floating chats. Needs Android 11 or newer. Chat heads also needs Messenger's own Chat heads switch, and Android bubbles need Messenger's bubbles allowed in Android's notification setti…
Allow screenshots

Lets you screenshot protected chat media, such as view-once photos and Quicksnap, and stops screenshot notices. It doesn't add replay or saving. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.
Auto reply

Answers messages with replies you write in HushMessenger settings, when they have words you pick or any message at all. Replies go out through Messenger's own notification reply, encrypted chats too, at most once every five minutes per cha…
Bold and italic text

Adds Bold and Italic to the menu that shows when you select words you typed. They're special Unicode letters, so they show on any phone, but screen readers may read them oddly. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.
Clone install under another package name

Installs a second copy of Messenger beside the first, with its own app name. Push notifications may not reach the copy. Pick it in Morphe Manager's Expert mode. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.
Custom new-message sound
Replaces Messenger's new-message sound with an .ogg, .mp3, .m4a or .wav file (1 MB or less) that you choose. Pick it in Morphe Manager's Expert mode. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.
Fix videos that won't send

Messenger stops two kinds of video with "Unable to send". One is a video whose only sound is xHE-AAC, which Facebook and Instagram now use. The other is a Samsung screen recording whose recorder tag Messenger's media check rejects. Whether…
Hide ad banners in business chats
In a chat you started from a business's ad, hides the banner that shows that ad. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.
Hide AI sticker tools

Hides the Generate and Generate AI sticker buttons, the AI sticker tab and AI sticker suggestions. Custom and music stickers in the Generate menu go with it. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.
Hide avatar stickers
Hides the avatar tab in the sticker keyboard. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.
Hide business reply suggestions
Hides suggested replies in conversations with businesses. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.
Hide business typing suggestions
Hides business suggestions that pop up as you type. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.
Hide Chat Moments
Hides Chat Moments in the menu. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.
Hide chat promotions
Hides promotion banners inside conversations. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.
Hide event prompts
Hides event promotion prompts inside chats. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.
Hide Facebook shortcuts

Hides Facebook buttons, profile and sharing shortcuts, and the Also from Meta and Subscriptions sections in the Menu tab. Handy if you only use Messenger. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.
Hide friend request cards
Hides friend request cards in your chat list so they stop taking up room. It doesn't accept or decline anyone. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.
Hide growth prompts

Hides prompts to add more people, the tip sheets in notes (like Make my notes public), and the Share your own story card after someone else's stories. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.
Hide inbox promotions
Hides promotion banners in your chat list. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.
Hide inbox tabs
Hides the Home and Channels tabs inside your inbox. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.
Hide joined community chats

Hides the community chats you joined from your main chat list. Search and community folders still show them. Messages and unread counts don't change. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.
Hide Mark as read

Hides Mark as read in the menu you get when you press and hold a chat in your chat list, so you can't mark a chat read by accident. Mark as unread stays. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.
Hide Meta AI

Hides the Meta AI floating button, toolbar button, tab and menu entries, plus AI in search and in @ suggestions. Restart Messenger to see the tab go. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.
Hide Notifications tab
Hides the Notifications tab in the bar at the bottom. Restart Messenger to see the tab go. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.
Hide People tab
Hides the People tab in the bar at the bottom. Restart Messenger to see the tab go. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.
Hide People You May Know
Hides suggested people in chats, search and stories, and on the People and Notifications tabs, so you only see people you know. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.
Hide read receipts

Opening a chat no longer tells people you read their message, and the chat stays unread on this phone. Marking it read yourself or replying in it marks it read and shows Seen, like Messenger does. Group chats aren't tested. Messenger's own…
Hide Reels badge
Hides the Reels notification badge. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.
Hide stories and notes
Hides the row of stories and notes above your chats. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.
Hide tab badges

Hides the red dots and counts on the tabs at the bottom and on the Facebook button at the top. Turn on Keep for any you still want. Restart Messenger to see the change. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.
Hide the recent photo card

Stops the card above the message box that offers to send the screenshot, photo or video you just took. You can still send it from the gallery. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.
Hide typing indicator
Stops Messenger from showing others when you're typing, even in end-to-end encrypted chats. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.
Hold stories at the end

Keeps a story on screen when it ends instead of moving on to the next one, so you go on with a tap or a swipe. Photos and videos both wait, and the last story stays open until you close it. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings…
Ignore the swipe up for disappearing messages

Swiping up at the bottom of a chat no longer turns on disappearing messages, so a scroll can't set the timer by accident. You can still change it in the chat's settings. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.
Install beside Meta apps

Lets your patched Messenger install next to Facebook and other Meta apps. Without it, the apps can clash over shared permissions and the install can stop at a blank screen. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.
Keep a message log

Saves each message when its notification arrives, so you can still read it if it's unsent. Works in end-to-end encrypted chats too. Stays on your phone. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.
Keep emoji search on emoji
Typing while the emoji keyboard is open no longer jumps to sticker search. The keyboard stays on emoji. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.
Keep unsent messages

Keeps messages on screen after someone unsends them, in chats where it works. Encrypted chats aren't supported, and group chats aren't tested. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.
Mark as read button

Puts Messenger's Mark as read icon in a chat's top bar while Hide read receipts is on. Opening the chat still sends nothing, and a tap on the icon sends Seen and marks the chat read. It takes the place of the chat details button, since tap…
Material You theme

Colors Messenger's dark mode with your wallpaper colors on Android 12 and newer, and a fixed blue on Android 11. Light mode stays the same. Turn on dark mode in Messenger first. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.
Open settings from menu

Adds a HushMessenger entry to Messenger's Menu tab and side menu, and makes a long press on the Messenger logo at the top of Chats or on the Menu tab's title open these settings too. Works as soon as you patch it in. The settings App tab c…
Open web links externally
Opens web links (http and https) in your default browser instead of inside Messenger. Other link types work as before. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.
Open your gallery app

The gallery button in a chat opens your phone's own gallery app. One photo or video opens in Messenger's editor for that chat, ready to send. Pick several and Messenger's Send to sheet opens with all of them and that chat at the top. Start…
Pin more chats

Raises Messenger's limit of three pinned chats to 20, so you can keep more chats at the top of your chat list. Messenger's servers can still stop you sooner. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.
Quiet incoming calls

Calls still come in, but Messenger doesn't ring, vibrate or pop the call up over your screen. The call waits in the notification shade with Answer and Decline. A call you miss still shows in the chat. If the Facebook app is on your phone,…
Restore old emoji drawer

Turns off Meta's redesigned emoji keyboard, so you keep the earlier layout. Restart Messenger after changing it. If Meta never gave you the redesign, nothing changes. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.
Restore screens on re-signed builds

Patching and signing Messenger yourself can break some of its screens. This makes Messenger's signature check pass again, including for a Facebook you patched with the same key, and lets Threads and Instagram video links open in a Threads…
Save any story
Adds Save to the More options menu on other people's stories, so you can keep their photo or video on your phone. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.
Send photos at original quality

With HD on, sends a JPEG photo at its full size instead of Messenger's smaller copy, so it stays sharp. Location is still removed. Photos over 20 MB are still made smaller. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.
Send videos without re-encoding

Sends a video as the original file instead of a recompressed copy, when Messenger allows it. Videos over 25 MB, edited videos and some formats are still compressed. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.
Slide chats in and out
Slides a chat in from the side when you open it and back out when you go back. Chat heads and bubbles keep their own animations. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.
Spoof package version

Gives Messenger a high version number so the Play Store stops offering Meta's updates. Messenger may report it to Meta. Going back means uninstalling first, which erases its data. Pick it in Expert mode. Works as soon as you patch it in, w…
Stop ad attribution uploads
Stops the job that reads your phone's advertising ID and sends it to Meta with your ad tracking setting. The ID itself doesn't change. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.
Stop analytics uploads

Stops the background services Messenger uses to upload usage statistics. It still records them on your phone, and they can upload after you turn this off. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.
Stop app list and device ID sharing

Stops Messenger from going through the apps on your phone to find other Meta apps, and from asking them for the device ID Meta uses to link the apps on one phone. Messenger keeps the ID it already has. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMesseng…
Stop inbox and ad link logging

Stops two reports Messenger logs. One says which part of your chat list was on screen, which Messenger files under inbox ads. The other says which ad brought you in when a link from an ad opens a chat. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMesseng…
Stop live connection logging

Drops the health reports and push logging Messenger sends over its live connection (MQTT). Messenger sends most of its traffic another way, so there's often little for it to drop. Messages, calls and active status keep working. Starts off.…
Stop nearby scans

Stops Messenger from reading the list of Wi-Fi networks around you, and hides the name and hardware address of the one you're connected to, the way Android does when Messenger can't see your location. Also stops the timer it can run while…
Unlock app icons

Lets you pick any icon in Messenger's App icon setting without a subscription. Messenger still decides whether that setting shows for your account. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.
Use system emoji
Shows emoji in your phone's own style instead of Messenger's. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.
Use the phone's camera app
The camera button in a chat opens your phone's own camera app. The photo then opens in Messenger's editor, ready to send. Photos only. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.
Use your own font

Shows Messenger's text in your phone's font instead of Meta's, or in a .ttf or .otf file you pick in HushMessenger settings. Emoji don't change. Restart Messenger after changing it. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Contro…
View stories anonymously
Opens other people's stories without adding you to their viewer list. Messenger still marks them as seen on your side. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.
